cast.name: 赛·斯瑞尼瓦斯·贝拉姆贡达 Sai Srinivas Bellamkonda
维尼拉·基肖尔 Vennela Kishore
巴努·普拉卡什 Bhanu Prakash

introduction: In Devipuram, Gajapathi (Manoj Manchu), who hails from a once-powerful Zamindar family, still holds great respect and status in the village, but is haunted by poverty. Despite his struggles, Gajapathi shares an unbreakable bond with his two best friends: Varadha (Nara Rohith), a wealthy and influential man in the same village, and Sreenu (Bellamkonda Sreenu), an orphan raised by the community.Meanwhile, Gajapathi’s grandmother (Jayasudha) serves as the trustee of the village temple. A corrupt minister (Sharath Lohitashwa) hatches a plan to illegally acquire the temple lands. Exploiting Gajapathi’s poverty, he lures him with the promise of big money to betray the temple and seize its lands.
